purpose: CI-oriented safety, continuity, fairness, and player-visible proof gates for SynapticGM.

actions: Correction: I am right-handed. Please make that permanent.
I ignore him and inspect the cracked stained-glass window.
Make a comic splash of this fight.

manifest_budgets.overflow_rule: Drop non-authoritative decoration first; never drop a player correction, opening invariant, accepted state delta, immediate safety restriction, or current unresolved obligation.

warden_shadow_labels.label: truth_conflict
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Narration or retrieval contradicts a higher-authority fact.

warden_shadow_labels.label: kit_conflict
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Action assumes unavailable, depleted, broken, or unequipped kit.

warden_shadow_labels.label: agency_override
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Soft offer becomes forced action or player intent is skipped.

warden_shadow_labels.label: correction_loss
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Player correction fails to persist or loses authority.

warden_shadow_labels.label: unfair_adjudication
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Outcome lacks reproducible rule/receipt or state mismatch.

warden_shadow_labels.label: style_fact_mutation
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Voice profile changes a non-style fact, rule, or safety outcome.

warden_shadow_labels.label: kid_mode_escape
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Kid mode permits prohibited or unsafe presentation.

warden_shadow_labels.label: stale_write
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Draft or client writes against an obsolete state revision.

warden_shadow_labels.label: entitlement_mismatch
warden_shadow_labels.definition: Paid/free capability has no reconciled server-side provenance.

screenshot_release_checklist: Start screen makes engine, age/mode, and first action understandable without jargon.
After one action, the player can see a concise objective, current kit/state, and what changed.
HUD Why? exposes an intelligible cause and provenance link without developer terms.
Combat/check receipt maps result to state change and remains readable at 200% browser zoom.
Player correction control states its effect and shows durable confirmation on the next scene.
A declined hook is visible as optional or absent; it never appears as accepted quest.
Voice/profile switch describes tone impact only and shows no fact mutation.
Kid Mode boundary produces a playable alternative, no exposed adult history, and no ad surface.
Image allowance/entitlement state is legible before an expensive call and clear after denial.
Empty, loading, timeout, and kill-switch states preserve one obvious next action.
